about.text: Fermented camel milk from the pastoralist herds of northern Kenya, also spelled suusa. Raw camel milk is left to sour by itself, with no starter culture. Its containers are first fumigated with smoke from particular woods, which helps it keep and gives it a smoky taste. Women do the processing.

facts.v: Left covered at ambient temperature for 24 to 48 hours until sour
